finalText:
**Big, but mostly mechanical.** 1082 hits across 94 files.

| Zone | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services/**` JS vars | 75 | Yes |
| `lib/audit.js` | 1 | Yes |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | No, public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 1 | No, frozen wire name |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | No, regenerated |
| `migrations/**` | 12 | No, applied history |

One more trap. The SQL column stays `account_id` inside repo files. Only a new migration can rename it.

Ask the platform team for two things. A new dated API version, or a serializer that maps `owner_id` back to `account_id`. And a fresh migration, not edits to old ones.
